message:
Added device hangs below deck with no change seen from above.

Structural Dynamicist and Under-Deck Integration Designer, the support stays workable without drilling or deck closure. The hung load is moving mass plus frame pulled by gravity, with total 9.81 kN per the total static hung load Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), a sprung mass that moves out of phase, plus frame (E29), carried by clamped friction beam clamps to the girder bottom flanges as in the midspan TMD layout sketch (E12). That load equals about thirteen adults of 75 kg, small against the assumed 20000 kg modal mass behind the Size under-deck TMD mass tuning and damping for 1.9 Hz mode (E11), and one clamp pair covers it because the Type CF High Friction Clamp, Galvanised - Grampian Fasteners (E23) gives 16 kN in friction and the Lindapter's M24 Type AF Steelwork Fixing (E24) gives 35 kN Safe Working Load (SWL), allowed working load, in friction per the Steelwork and Rail Fixings (E25).

Corrosion and upkeep are handled hidden below deck. Hot-dip galvanized steel, zinc coated by dipping in molten zinc, stays maintenance-free outdoors, with 20 to 50 years maintenance-free life per the Hot Dip Galvanized Material (E28), plus a lock-off pin for maintenance that pins the 800 kg TMD still for inspection and locked nuts against detuning, fitted from a mobile lift below.

I veto any concept needing deck-level structures or deck appearance change. Not ready, because modal mass and dynamic stroke still need freezing with Structural Dynamicist.
